header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner; nor intimation received.
body: This petition was filed in year 2019 with the prayer that private respondents No. 8 to 10 be restrained from cultivating agricultural land from the Well which was allotted by the Government and N.G.O for the purpose of drinking water of Thar people. Since 2019 the petitioner is not pursuing instant petition, which reflects that grievance of the petitioner has been redressed. In such a situation instant petition has become infructuous, hence same alongwith listed pending application is hereby disposed of.
